The Mission

Helping fathers heal, grow, reconnect, and create a healthier legacy.

Daddy Hunger began with a simple but painful truth: many children grow up longing for the presence, protection, affirmation, and love of a father.

Today, Daddy Hunger is a mission to help fathers become more present, emotionally healthy, trustworthy, and prepared so that every child can feel safe, seen, heard, loved, and prepared.

Read the Daddy Hunger story →

The Five Promises

What every child should experience through a father.

01

Safe

A child can tell the truth, ask for help, admit a mistake, or share fear without humiliation or abandonment.

02

Seen

A child knows their father notices who they are, not only what they accomplish.

03

Heard

A child feels that their thoughts, emotions, questions, and experiences matter.

04

Loved

A child knows love is not something they must earn through performance, agreement, or perfection.

05

Prepared

A child receives the wisdom, values, confidence, and practical guidance needed to face life.

The Forthcoming Book

Ten principles for healing, responsibility, connection, and legacy.

The 10 Commandments of Fatherhood draws from Ray’s childhood, his experience raising two sons, the lessons of divorce and rebuilding, and the stories encountered through Daddy Hunger.

This is not a book about perfect fathers. It is a book about fathers willing to tell the truth, repair what they can, and keep becoming.

About Ray Upchurch

A father, grandfather, speaker, filmmaker, and creator of Daddy Hunger.

Ray’s journey into fatherhood began with questions about becoming a good father without having known his own. Through raising his sons, rebuilding after hardship, and years of listening to families across the country, he learned that presence, emotional safety, truth, and love are essential.

Meet Ray

The Vision

Heal the Father. Reach the Child. Transform the Legacy.

Daddy Hunger is growing into a platform for books, practical resources, speaking engagements, workshops, family experiences, media projects, partnerships, and transformational events.
